summary: Legacy bare text field, hidden from the picker. Use the Text Input control (net.noodl.controls.textinput) in new graphs.
description: The legacy Text Input renders an unstyled input/textarea with the basic text surface (`onTextChanged` string output, focus/blur/clear signals). It remains registered for old projects but is hidden from the node picker; the Text Input control supersedes it with label/icon support, visual states and theming.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use net.noodl.controls.textinput instead.
runtimeBehavior: Declared-port-groups: size-mode and option-dependent ports swap by parameters, as on other visual nodes.
